title: Enhancing Virtual Agents through SLMs and Edge-Computing: An Exploratory Evaluation of Think and Memory Processes
abstract: arXiv:2608.13420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embodied intelligent virtual agents are expected to operate as persistent, adaptive, and context-aware entities within complex virtual and Metaverse worlds. However, implementing cognitively capable agents in such environments is conceptually and technologically challenging. Among a range of blueprints and development approaches, the Cognitive Embodied Agent Architecture (CEAA) has been developed as an implementation-oriented framework for architecting components of perception, memory, reasoning, planning, and embodied action. translated_title: 通过SLM和边缘计算增强虚拟代理：思考与记忆过程的探索性评估
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13420v1 公告类型：新 摘要：具身智能虚拟代理预期在复杂虚拟世界和元宇宙环境中作为持久、自适应且上下文感知的实体运行。然而，在此类环境中实现具有认知能力的代理在概念上和技术上都极具挑战性。在各种蓝图和开发方法中，认知具身代理架构（CEAA）已被开发为一种面向实现的框架，用于构建感知、记忆、推理、规划和具身行动等组件。考虑到边缘计算和生成式AI语言模型的最新进展，本文探讨了使用小型语言模型（SLMs）来支持基于边缘的选定CEAA组件运行，重点关注“思考”和“记忆”作为虚拟代理在交互式虚拟世界中认知编排和持久性的核心过程。开发并评估了一个基于边缘的虚拟代理网关系统。
tldr: 本文探索了利用小型语言模型在边缘计算环境中支持虚拟代理的思考与记忆过程，提出并评估了一个基于边缘的网关系统，以增强代理在虚拟世界中的认知持久性。
en_tdlr: This paper explores using small language models on edge computing to support virtual agents' think and memory processes, proposing and evaluating an edge-based gateway system to enhance cognitive persistence in virtual worlds.
